text:
amanda: Hey team — first week here! I'm in the rotation next week and trying to get my on-call checklist in order. I don't have PagerDuty access yet and the runbook links I found look outdated. Who can sherpa me through access + a quick practice run before my first pager?

devon: Welcome Amanda :wave: I'm your on‑call buddy for this rotation. Quick checklist: 1) Accept the PagerDuty invite (link below) 2) Request Slack access to #prod-alerts and #oncall-ops 3) Request 'oncall' role in Okta for Grafana/BigQuery/GCS 4) Walkthrough runbooks and do a 30m simulated pager with someone. I'll ping infra to send the invite. Links: https://pd.redwood.ai/accept/INVITE_TOKEN and https://confluence.redwood.ai/oncall/runbooks (start with "prod-service-index").

devon: Common places to request access: Okta -> Applications -> "Redwood Prod" -> Request access. For infra creds open a ticket in #help with subject: "oncall access: Amanda". If you hit a 403 on Grafana, attach the screenshot and the Okta request ID.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Scheduled test alert will be sent to @amanda and @devon in 30s for verification. (This is an automated test.)

mike: I can pair for the sim on Wed 10am PT (30–45m). We usually do a smoke alert that exercises the routing + runbook steps. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.ai/j/6321. I'll run through: acknowledge, investigate, escalate, and postmortem stub.

jordan: Quick note on escalation: primary oncall handles immediate mitigation. If it's SEV2+, follow the runbook heading "Escalation -> Exec Alert" and page the oncall-2 (PD escalation policy). After mitigation, open an incident in the Incident Manager: https://ops.redwood.ai/incidents/new and link the PD incident ID.

tayla: A few gotchas new folks hit: - Bastion SSH access (file a help ticket if you don't have jump host rights) - GCP project viewer vs editor (need viewer + logs access) - Bigtable read perms for the metrics dashboard. Example SSH via bastion if you need to pull logs: ```ssh -J bastion@bastion.prod.redwood svc-monitor@prod-node-3``` Also if you're testing alerts from your laptop use the internal test endpoint: ```curl -X POST https://alert-test.internal.redwood/api/fire -H 'Authorization: Bearer <test-token>' -d '{"service":"example","severity":"critical"}'```

amanda: Thanks all — super helpful. @devon can you add me to the Wed pairing? I'll post my Okta request ID once submitted. Also, any suggested runbooks to read first?

devon: Add you now. Start with: "prod-service-index" -> pick the service you'll own this rotation (we listed it in the rotation doc). Then read "pg-failover-runbook" and "incident-comms-template". I'll DM the exact service name.

mike: I'll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-read (two one‑pager links). We'll do one cold alert and one guided walkthrough.

amanda: Perfect — thanks! I'll confirm once PagerDuty shows me as 'on call' and after Okta is approved. :thumbsup:
